integrity: The new result is a double-scaling period and original-time occupation theorem. The underlying Hamiltonian, exact quadratures, and previously established symmetric-rate results are acknowledged prior work.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive c, deterministic positive periodic orbits; no uniform statement as c approaches zero or infinity, and no stochastic population conclusions. Some older full texts were not accessible.
title: A singular rate–energy crossover and uniform predator-log occupation in Lotka–Volterra cycles
